senses.gloss:
Nāya in two passages of the Rigveda is, according to the St. Petersburg Dictionary, probably a proper name. Sāyaṇa takes the word to mean ‘leader,’ while Pischel considers it a gerund with passive sense.
Foot notes vi. 24, 10; 46, 11.
Vedische Studien, 1, 41. For other explanations, see Oldenberg, ṚgvedaNoten, 1, 123, 370.
